title: Kestrel and the Hymn
author: Mara Hartwell
blurb: Xanthe Okonkwo, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must learn the song's last verse without singing along before the frost writes its final pattern.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
